summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing fiscal third quarter 2026 financial results. The release reports 15% constant-currency revenue growth and raises FY26 guidance for revenue growth and Adjusted EBITDA to at least EUR 710 million. It details segment performance, margin changes, and an accelerated share repurchase affecting leverage. This is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special category applies. The filing is informational only, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics to analyze.
